area: workflow runs: the fields line of a method prompt
old: 784f78d's prompt for a step that calls a method named the fields of the method's JSON answer in the order the agent file lists them (the extract method: vendor, amount, note).
new: The engine names them in name order (amount, note, vendor), because runs keep their definitions as canonical JSON. The rest of the prompt and the answer are the same; HAL-7123 makes this an allowed difference once a user key can sign its note (HAL-3434).
tests: billing/invoice/an approved invoice is paid and announced
billing/invoice/a rejection with a comment ends in rejected
billing/invoice/an approval nobody answers expires after two days
billing/invoice/without a decision the run waits

area: CLI runs: a connector that isn't signed in
old: 784f78d's studio run refused to start the invoice workflow, whose hub has a Google connector for billing@example.com that wasn't signed in: "Not started: Sign in billing@example.com first (Inbox).", exit code 1, no run stored.
new: In 0.1 a CLI run gets no connectors at all (cli.local-engine), so nothing checks sign-in: halonic run starts the run and stores it; with the echo model it then fails at the lines step, whose checker doesn't answer JSON. HAL-5291 brings the check back with the connectors.
